description: This file defines reporting-related functions, types, and constants for the Ginkgo testing framework, including report generation, report entry management, and suite lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: CurrentSpecReport
methods.description: Returns information about the current running spec as a SpecReport.

methods.name: CurrentTreeConstructionNodeReport
methods.description: Returns information about the current container nodes leading to the current path in the spec tree.

methods.name: AddReportEntry
methods.description: Generates and adds a new ReportEntry to the current spec's report, with optional visibility and location decorations.

methods.name: ReportBeforeEach
methods.description: Registers a node to run before each spec, for reporting purposes.

methods.name: ReportAfterEach
methods.description: Registers a node to run after each spec, for reporting purposes.

methods.name: ReportBeforeSuite
methods.description: Registers a node to run at the beginning of the test suite, for reporting purposes.

methods.name: ReportAfterSuite
methods.description: Registers a node to run at the end of the test suite, for reporting purposes.

methods.name: registerReportAfterSuiteNodeForAutogeneratedReports
methods.description: Sets up a report node to generate various report formats based on the reporter configuration.
